Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task and misidentified the subject. They assumed the LinkedIn result for a DreamPay co-founder referred to the “Sachin Warrier” in question and treated DreamPay as the company he “worked for as a software engineer.” They failed to disambiguate between individuals with the same name and to verify which company he was a software engineer at, leading them to look up DreamPay’s HQ instead of the correct employer’s headquarters.
